author: Shaurya Kumar Pathak
title: The Blinkit Review
review: Blinkit (formerly Grofers) is an outstanding platform for anyone looking for a quick, efficient, and reliable grocery delivery service. One of its best features is the speed—most orders arrive within minutes, which is perfect for last-minute needs or busy schedules. The app's user interface is intuitive, making it easy to navigate through a wide range of products, from fresh produce to household essentials. The quality of the items is consistently high, and they offer a good variety of brands, ensuring that both premium and budget-friendly options are available. Their customer service is responsive and helpful, addressing any issues or concerns promptly. Blinkit’s regular offers and discounts add even more value, making grocery shopping both convenient and economical. Overall, Blinkit provides a seamless shopping experience, ensuring that customers receive fresh, high-quality products with lightning-fast delivery. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a hassle-free way to shop for groceries!

author: Rashna Garg
title: Blinkit - A Mixed-Bag Grocery App
review:
I’ve been using Blinkit for the past few months to get everyday essentials without stepping out, and overall it does a decent job. The interface is clean and the categorisation makes it easy to find what you need—whether it’s a pack of atta, a bottle of shampoo, or a quick snack. Delivery is usually prompt, and the live‑tracking map, while not perfect, gives a reasonable idea of when the rider will arrive.

That said, the biggest drawback is the limited cash‑on‑delivery (COD) option. Most items show COD as unavailable, pushing users toward online payments, which can be inconvenient when you’re trying to stick to a strict budget or simply prefer paying with cash. I’ve also noticed occasional glitches with the payment gateway and a few instances where the estimated delivery time was off by a significant margin. Customer support, when reachable, is polite but not particularly swift in resolving issues.

In short, Blinkit is a convenient solution for those who are comfortable with digital payments and can tolerate occasional hiccups. If COD is a non‑negotiable requirement for you, it may be worth keeping a backup grocery source handy.

author: rahkihs
title: Extremely Dissatisfying Experience
review: I regret to share that my experience with the Blinkit app over the past three months has been consistently disappointing. The issues primarily revolve around frequent offline status and significantly prolonged delivery times, which have not lived up to the promised service level. First and foremost, Blinkit's app has been offline on multiple occasions, making it frustratingly unreliable. As a user, I expect a seamless experience with minimal downtime, but unfortunately, Blinkit has failed to deliver on this front. Additionally, the app's delivery times have been far from the 10-minute window initially advertised. Instead, orders have taken anywhere from 25 to 60 minutes to arrive, which is significantly longer than expected. This prolonged waiting period has caused considerable inconvenience, especially during time-sensitive situations. Moreover, the services provided by Blinkit have been consistently subpar. The quality of customer support is lacking, with slow response times and inadequate assistance when resolving issues. As a customer, I feel that my concerns have been overlooked, and the lack of attention to addressing service problems is deeply disheartening. Overall, my experience with Blinkit has been nothing short of appalling. The app's frequent offline status, prolonged delivery times, and inadequate customer support have eroded any trust I initially had in the platform. I had hoped for a reliable and efficient service, but instead, I have encountered continuous frustration and disappointment. As a result of these ongoing issues, I am compelled to give Blinkit a one-star review. I sincerely hope that the company takes these concerns seriously and takes immediate action to improve its services. Until then, I regretfully cannot recommend Blinkit to others seeking a reliable and timely delivery app.

author: aniketmhatre
title: Observations on Increased Spending Due to App Convenience
review:
I would like to share my feedback regarding my experience with the Blinkit application.
After installing the app, I have noticed that my overall spending on daily purchases has increased significantly. While the convenience of quick delivery is appreciated, it has also encouraged unnecessary and impulsive shopping, leading to expenses that I might otherwise have avoided.
Earlier, I used to walk to nearby stores for essential purchases, which helped me stay active and make more mindful buying decisions. Since using the app, that habit has reduced, as the ease of ordering has replaced physical visits to stores.
While the application is well-designed and efficient, I feel it promotes overconsumption due to its constant availability and ease of use. I believe features encouraging mindful purchasing or better expense tracking could greatly improve the user experience.

review:

First, I was told no replacement was available because the item was out of stock. Then I was told a refund could only be processed after pickup. But the moment I raised a complaint on the application, their prompt response surprised me. They immediately arranged for a replacement and within no time, I received a brand new tube light. I was really impressed with their efficiency and customer service. It's always a relief when companies prioritize their customers and go the extra mile to rectify any issues. I appreciate the quick resolution provided by Blinkit and would definitely recommend their application to others. Kudos to the team for their outstanding work!

author: @BP4
title: Double Payments, Delayed Refunds & Poor Quality – Very Frustrating Experience with Blinkit
review:
I had a very disappointing experience with Blinkit.

Blinkit should make a clear policy to ensure immediate refunds for customer concerns, especially in cases of failed payments or damaged products. Delayed refunds only add to customer frustration.

Once, I ordered bananas but they were completely unripe — so raw that they couldn’t be eaten for at least 2 days. After I made the payment, I received a notification saying “payment failed.” If the payment had actually failed, how was the amount deducted from my account? I ended up paying the same amount again. Later, I was informed that the refund had been initiated and would take 3–5 working days. This kind of confusion is unacceptable.

Why should a customer have to pay twice for the same product? And even after that, refunds are not processed immediately.

Today, I faced a similar issue again. I ordered an item that arrived damaged. When I requested a return, I was told the refund would again take 3–5 working days.

Also, I placed an order on 17th March, and as of today (23rd March), I still haven’t received that refund. Now, another refund has been initiated with the same 3–5 working day timeline.

Overall, this has been a very frustrating experience. Definitely one of the worst experiences I’ve had with Blinkit.

author: Papasumit
title: Fraud app

For the last 1 hour, your executives have been saying:

“I am checking with the team”

“I am transferring your case”

“Please wait”

But no solution, no clarity, and no resolution has been provided. I am just being passed around intentionally, which is extremely unprofessional and unacceptable.

This experience has wasted my time and caused unnecessary frustration. As a customer, I expect honesty, transparency, and quick resolution, not excuses and delays.

I demand the following immediately:

Full refund or replacement without any further unnecessary proofs

Proper explanation for the wrong product information shown on the app

Strict action against the support executives who are mishandling my case

If this issue is not resolved promptly, I will be forced to escalate this matter to higher authorities and consumer grievance platforms, as this is a clear case of false advertising and poor customer service.

I expect a clear and final resolution at the earliest.

author: Ashu Lamare
title: Focus on Refund experience- disappointed
review:
I’ve been really disappointed with my experience using the Blinkit app, especially when it comes to refunds. While the idea of quick grocery delivery is appealing, the reality has been frustrating. There have been multiple times when:
Orders were incorrect or items were missing, and getting a refund has been a slow, complicated process.
Refund timelines are unclear — even after cancellation, the refund doesn’t show up for days, and there’s no clear status update in the app.
Customer support is unhelpful — responses are slow, generic, and often don’t resolve the issue, leaving me chasing updates.
For an app built around convenience, the refund process feels anything but convenient. It’s disappointing that something as basic as timely and transparent refunds isn’t handled well. I hope Blinkit improves this aspect soon, because right now it’s overshadowing the ease of placing orders.

author: David Raynell
title: Extremely Disappointed – Poor Service & Unfair Refund Policy
review:
I had a terrible experience with Blinkit and feel completely cheated. I had ordered Xerox prints (6 pages, approx ₹60) using their app. To avoid the delivery charges, Blinkit prompted me to purchase additional items worth ₹200 for free delivery. So, I added a watermelon and a buttermilk, taking the total bill to around ₹250.

The order was delivered, but to my shock, the Xerox prints were completely messed up – some pages were missing, and others were cut halfway and printed improperly. I had uploaded a properly formatted PDF, so the mistake was entirely on Blinkit’s end.

When I contacted customer care, they agreed to refund only the Xerox amount. I explained that the only reason I bought the watermelon and buttermilk was to meet the free delivery requirement – they were not items I actually needed. I requested them to either:
	1.	Make the next printout delivery free, or
	2.	Take back the unwanted items and give a full refund

Shockingly, they refused both options and insisted on refunding only ₹60. This is unacceptable and feels like a trap. I ended up wasting time, effort, and money — and got absolutely nothing useful in return.

This is clear cheating. Blinkit is encouraging people to spend more just to waive delivery, and when their own service fails, they refuse to take proper responsibility.

I strongly do NOT recommend using Blinkit for printing services. Their customer service is unhelpful, and their policies lack basic fairness and logic. Avoid this app if you don’t want to be taken for a ride.

author: saurabhrai900
title: Fraud company — only safe for Rs 5–10 kirana items
review:
1 star — Warning to all customers.

Blinkit is a total fraud when it comes to anything beyond small kirana items. Order a Rs 5–10 packet of biscuits or salt — sure, it'll reach you. But the moment you order anything expensive, be ready to get cheated.

My experience: THREE back-to-back orders with missing items. Every single time, items I paid for were just not in the bag. Coincidence? Not a chance.

And the worst part — there is ZERO real customer support:
- No phone number to call
- No human agent
- Just a useless bot chat that loops you in circles
- And a pathetic email support that copy-pastes "sorry for the inconvenience"

When I complained, they straight up closed the chat saying "store confirmed item was not missing." No proof, no investigation, no chance for me to respond. Thank god I record every unboxing on camera — otherwise I would have been silently robbed.

My honest advice to anyone reading this:
- Use Blinkit ONLY for cheap kirana items (Rs 5–50 stuff).
- DO NOT order expensive products, electronics, or premium groceries — you WILL be cheated and there is no one to help you recover your money.
- ALWAYS record your unboxing. Without video proof, your complaint means nothing to them.

Blinkit has become a scam in a fancy app wrapper. Switching to Zepto / Instamart / local kirana. At least they answer the phone.

Avoid this company unless you enjoy endless frustration and zero support.

It drains battery and if left in the pocket without turning off the screen manually, such chats or accidental  clicks are bound to happen. It’s annoying. Please fix it.

author: TedLassoFootball
title: Half the items undelivered on prepaid orders
review: I have faced this issue for the 8th time in 4 months. I order items, prepaid order. Half the items aren’t delivered. Payment already made. No intimation from the app regarding missing items. If it skips your mind, there’s nothing that can be done. By chance we realise items missing - there is a chat where we complain again And again and they apologise and refund money. I have begun to believe that a mistake can’t happen repeatedly and there has to be some glitch here. Someone is either deliberately taking items that are already paid for or there is some scam somewhere. They don’t let me write a written complaint or let me escalate the matter. They keep changing the customer care executive and I have to keep repeating the same issue. There definitely is some issue going on. The packets received are not even sealed. And since then this issue has started.

author: Savita’s
title: Worst delivery app
review: Not one but 2 incidents which really brings real concerns, so first incident i basically ordered some things and the delivery guy refused to give me my order because I asked him to follow maps since i do not know the area after an argument he still refused to give my order he then called his friends and hit my security guard. I called the customer service crying scared for my life as it was late at night and i was a girl living alone they still never processed a refund. Did not take any action, they claim to have fired him but I’ve seen him delivery to the building. Recently a month ago i finally used it as they were the only ones open their delivery guy refused this time as the order was cigarettes. He came in late and refused to deliver the cigarettes. He came asked for name and stood took pictures of it and went away. I wrote to the support again, and they claim it was delivered and no refund will be provided.

author: Avishkar.k
title: A heartfelt thank you to the entire Blinkit Team
review:
Today, I witnessed something truly inspiring. A Blinkit ambulance arrived quickly during a medical emergency and provided its service completely free of cost. Seeing such a fast and compassionate response reminded me how important every minute is when someone’s life is at risk.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire Blinkit team for taking this initiative. Providing emergency ambulance services without charging patients is a remarkable step toward making healthcare more accessible and saving lives. Acts like these show that businesses can create a real, positive impact on society.

Thank you, Blinkit, for putting people first. Wishing your team continued success in this life-saving mission.

author: ibrahimmasood14
title: Change the app name to 24-48 hours
review: I ordered items from blinkit and an item was expired I contacted the team and they sent me the exchanged item which too was expired after waiting for an hour. I complained to the support team they asked for my details and wasted my another hour. After giving me so much trouble they are so smart to transfer the money to my blinkit wallet. I asked them to send me the money to my bank account as i wont be using the app after this experience and their team is so bad that they denied returning the taxes and delivery charges after giving me such a bad experience they should’ve paid me compensation instead they are delaying the payment i have contacted them 5 times wasted so much time every time they say the amount will be transferred within 24-48 hours also only the product amount not the charges. Please dont use their services they only play games and deliver expired products.

author: abhy rai
title: Urgency demanded in the Silicon Valley of India
review: The entire ecosystem of building startups in Bangalore is reflection of every evil corruption present in India. When Politicians don’t understand the requirements of redesigning the city, they bring true Bharat the one sacrifice is needed by delivery boys to reduce stress level of desk job employees who are building for Bharat. But I will wait and direct the guy so he gains credits by delivering order faster.

author: Alpinoshaha
title: Bad experience
review:
I had an extremely disappointing experience with Blinkit and its delivery partner. I placed an order with Cash on Delivery, but when the delivery agent arrived, he clearly refused to accept cash. Instead of completing the delivery, he asked me to cancel the order myself.
I contacted customer support, and while they did help in raising a complaint about the delivery partner, they clearly said they could not allow Cash on Delivery and did not provide any proper solution. On top of that, my COD option is now blocked without any proper explanation.
This whole experience shows a serious lack of coordination and accountability between Blinkit and its delivery partners. As a customer, I expect basic professionalism and respect for the payment option I selected at checkout. Very poor service and highly disappointing. I would not recommend ordering unless they seriously improve their delivery process and customer support handling.

author: Raja banna
title: Unpaid Transaction for Cancelled Order– Still Not Refunded
review:
I placed an order on Blinkit on 07 Oct 25 which was cancelled, but the refund transaction is still showing as "successful" on 14th October 2025. As of today, I have not received any refund for this order.
Despite the order being cancelled, the amount has not been credited back to my account. This delay is very disappointing and affects the trust I had in the service.
I kindly request Blinkit to resolve this issue immediately and process the refund at the earliest. Please also provide an update on the refund status.
Order details can be provided if required. Hoping for a quick resolution. Kindly look forward for customer care support on call.

author: Biks1985
title: Worse customer service
review: If you order any product and its not proper then its very difficult to return. They will use AI which doesn’t work properly and your return will not happen. They don’t give option to speak with customer care. I tried doing it many times while i try to return some vegetables which are not fresh and poor quality but couldn’t get in touch with them. Never use their service to order vegetables or fruits. If you do you will be disappointed that is as per my experience ordering multiple times. When ever you order vegetables or fruits they will get old stock from fridge and poor quality. So be aware of it.

author: Chandni_Mitra
title: Very Poor Experience with Blinkit – Cancelled Orders and No Refund
review:
I recently placed an order with Blinkit, but it was canceled without any notification, and I was issued a coupon instead of a refund. When I tried to use that coupon on another purchase, my second order was also canceled, and I was told I couldn’t receive a refund because I had “used a coupon.” That doesn’t make sense — it was my money, not a free gift coupon.

To date, I’ve communicated with six or seven customer support executives, all offering different stories and resolutions. I still don’t know the status of my refund and haven’t received any resolution. While I understand that mistakes happen, the lack of transparency, consistency, and honest support is unacceptable. Please think twice before ordering in bulk from Blinkit — their response has been nothing but evasive, and the customer support experience has been extremely frustrating.

author: asgr2
title: 8 Minutes Turned into 80: Blinkit's Delivery Disaster
review: Blinkit's 8-minute delivery promise is a blatant lie! I placed an urgent order, expecting it to arrive in a flash, only to be left hanging for a ridiculous 30 minutes. When I tried to cancel the order, they told me it was already on its way, as if I didn't know that already. To add insult to injury, the delivery guy called me after I had already left to tell me my order was there. Seriously? What a joke! Blinkit clearly doesn't care about their customers. Their app is a disaster, their customer service is non-existent, and their delivery times are a complete joke. It's completely unacceptable that Blinkit doesn't allow cancellations when orders are significantly delayed. It shows a complete lack of respect for their customers' time and needs. I'm so disappointed and angry. I'll never use Blinkit again, and I'll make sure everyone I know knows about this terrible experience.

author: AndreaThomas83
title: Worst customer service - is blinket actually becoming so arrogant!!!
review: Worst customer service!!! Never buy electronics from them - they will sell you a damaged or malfunctioning product and then their customer service will do some troubleshooting and then put it on the customer that they should contact the manufacturer. Thats how terrible they have become. They sell expired products! Then their adding address option is so terrible that the area location will select anything and then they will force the customer to cancel the order or they will cancel the order and they will charge like 20 bucks… lol. I give them business in thousandsssss… but blinket has become extremely arrogant and I don’t need that. I just use them now when I am not able to go out .. like from 1st app to go to they have now become my last option and I am extremely happy and at peace with this decision! :)

author: Morom21
title: no happy at all !!! 🫡
review: few days ago i received a opened packet of biryani masala, and i reported about it too but i got no response from blinkit, and now last night i ordered for my dinner and waited for 1 hour and didn’t receive my order and slept hungry, and now this morning i was weak and had no groceries in my kitchen so ordered some items for breakfast and same thing repeated again like the last night but now i had to wait for 2 hours straight and asked me to cancel the order due to traffic and weather. I am concerned with the situation but dear blinkit if u are do able to deliver your item at time please kindly place the cancel option so we could cancel it . And why should u have to wait for 1 hour straight to get a delivery partner, if they are not available within 20-30 minutes please do cancel the order or you are more concerned about your sales and earnings??? Not satisfied at all!!!

author: Jeffy@1
title: Pathetic service from the dilivery partner & also on chat support ,call back made absolutely rude.
review:
Almost took more than an hour for the product to be delivered by delivery partner. Called the partner several time no answer from the partner. On contacting the chat support, The call back from the agent was absolutely rude.. used words such as she doing her job…After wasting my valuable time for more than 90 mints … asking weather I would like to cancel my order… Rather getting the issue sorted and taking ownership just passing the information to customer as a messenger saying partner vehicle got punctured so it’s taking time…. Without retrospecting the exact issue. 

Me personally while tracking the app, The dilivery partner left the pickup location almost 45 mints before…and just reaching 4 mints away from the delivery location the person halted and gave info to the call back agent that he is getting the bike repaired… It should be obvious to check what the dilivery partner was doing for last 45 mints or so… 

Very poor tracking system…Anyway very bad experience will certainly escalate the matter further. 

Please do understand by doing so you are loosing the reputation of the company as there are competitor’s who are capable to give better service and customer experiences.

Be empathetic for the time wasted. Value time.

author: Blinkit_Customer
title: Delivery guy Behaviour
review:
I’m really a Blinkit fan not just a customer. 
But I had an issue with a recent Blinkit order received around 5:30 PM where one item was missing. While the support team was responsive and resolved the issue quickly which I really appreciate. But the delivery person returned to my home around 9 PM and insisted that he had delivered everything. I mentioned the missing item, but he kept repeating that nothing was left out. Only when I asked if he had actually counted or checked the items and then he admit that he didn’t remember.

I don’t think it was appropriate for the delivery person to come back to my home just to argue about a complaint he received. That kind of follow-up should be handled by customer support, not by confronting the customer in person. 
 I wanted to complain this issue with support team but one point came to my mind that he know my address now if I complain about this issue with support team he may again come to my location - this really scares me.

I hope Blinkit takes this feedback seriously and ensures better training and protocols for delivery staff. A smoother and more respectful experience goes a long way in building trust.

author: Alvin039
title: No solutions/service if high value items are stolen/missing
review:
I’ve used the app for the longest time. However, recently when a power bank was missing from the sealed delivery kit and I had to hop a flight for 2 days and inquired on this after return as it had been given as a gift, the team refused to help even when item was stolen from their warehouse. And I had to pay for it. No replacement/ refund/ update was provided even after follow ups multiple times.

Hence, be careful when ordering jog value items on the app or any electrical items- and check the deliveries before they leave itself. As the apps after sales service is zero!!!

author: Hawabaaz
title: Pathetic Customer Service
review: The delivery agents take the liberty for the time they want to deliver you . I took the slot of 10am to 1pm of a Sunday . I got a call at 7:30 am from the delivery agent to come down from the building and receive the order as the delivery agent said that he has to go other way for the orders and won’t be able to deliver afterwards . I clearly told him that my slot if from 10am to 1pm . He disturbed my sleep for his own motives . I refused to take the order as I was not going to hurry up in the morning and do all the lifting of my stuff from ground floor to 3rd as he was not even willing to leave the order at my door step that is in my complete address with Floor clearly mentioned . At 12 I received a call from the same guy saying that some milk has spil in my ordered items so he will not be able to deliver it today. Clearly from his morning motives I can say he was lying and for the fact that I had 6 tetra packs of milk whose leakage is next to impossible.

author: Mwchoudhary
title: Delivery Boy irritate me
review: "I've been using Blinkit for a while now, and while their service is generally convenient, I've been facing a really annoying issue lately. Their delivery boys keep calling me repeatedly, sometimes even after the order has been delivered. It's not just a one-time thing, it's happened multiple times. I understand that they might need to confirm the order or ask for directions, but it's getting excessive. I've asked them to stop calling me, but they just won't listen. It's really frustrating and invasive. I hope Blinkit takes steps to address this issue and trains their delivery boys to respect customers' boundaries. Until then, I'll have to think twice before using their service again."

author: Rohit99sharma
title: Downgraded quality, service and delivery.
review:
I used to be a regular grofers user for few years but lately some changes has led me to move to other better apps like bigbasket and flipkart supermart. Grofers has severely downgraded their products quality, customer service, decreased cards discount and even delivery partners are worse nowadays. 
In GOBD sales I thought of retrying grofers and move back to using it but like always my experience had been pathetic- I won an INAAM which was changed automatically to of lower value product, even on raising issue on multiple platforms like grofers app, twitter no one took responsibility to solve my issue. They replied after few days that they can't help now as order is delivered.  The delivery guy also comes much before the selected slot, customer service is pathetic.  I would recommend you guys to move to flipkart or bigbasket to get much better customer service and better quality.

author: Hya Ali
title: Way of Delivery
review:
The way of delivery of Grofers is not that great as compare to other online sites, I have hardly ever used grofers that much from a couple of months but the last few times I did it the delivery guy got lost and he went to a totally opposite place after my  proper conversation. Not only that, they don’t even rap the item very well. And the item is usually not in a great condition. I’m giving this app 4 stars only because I know they will improve this.  Rest everything is fine. The delivery usually takes about three to four days to arrive but that’s not the issue the issue is that the delivery item should atless be in a good condition!
I hope u improve this because I want to give u those 5 stars but there should atless be 5 things that I’m happy about! 👍

author: Suhak Mondal
title: Missing item
review: Very poor customer support, the agent does not listen. I ordered ₹1300 and with that order, a Blinkit was providing a free gift that was worth. I don’t know about that but cream. When I receive my order that item was missing customer support and this, they are saying this item is out of stock. Is out of stock item can be added to cart? I ask them to refund the value of that free item and they said it’s a free item. It cannot be refunded, so I informed them if I order ₹200 value items. Would you guys give me a free gift with that order, they don’t have any answer. I have been informing them that at least give me a voucher or a minimum like shot that the value of the item as a refund. It would be around ₹20-₹25 of free item. I am talking about the value of that free item. agent name was Kumari closed the chat on my face before I type something. I wish I should have placed the order

author: ShikhaReviewTime
title: Pathetic Customer Support
review:
Only order COD, check if you have received all products and only then pay for it else consider your money lost.

Context -
I ordered item of 2k Rupees from here. Due to their technical glitch they couldn’t service it and requested for a cancellation. On cancellation the executive said that they can only refund in form of coupon and I can reach out to support to get it refunded to source mode post than. On doing so, the other executive informed that it wasn’t possible as coupon was issued. This coupon needs to be used in full amount with 30 days validity. The item was out of stock. Next day I reordered the item it got delivered with missing item. On reaching to executive he informed that store is offline and I need to reach out to them again after few hours. Again, I reached out to them on next day and same story and on requesting for cancellation and refund to source account same story was repeated. 

Now on asking for the missing item to be delivered the team is saying that store is still offline and I need to reach out to them for fourth time once store is online. This is hilarious and life lesson for all online purchasing that I am going to do now onwards. And obviously blinkit, zomato both lost a customer.

Lesson - only do cod and post checking pay them. 

Thankyou.

author: Tanya Sakhun
title: Unsatisfied with the service (delivery agents)
review: Very rude behaviour of the delivery boys and girls! Not at all satisfied with the service provided to the customer. Since I live on the second floor, every time the delivery boys complain of some or the other problems just to avoid climbing the stairs. The delivery os supposed to be at the doorstep, so if I am at the second floor the order should be delivered there. This delivery girl, *Manju* did not even call me once she reached my place to deliver my order, just rang the bell and kept my order on the first step of the stairs. Inspite of me asking her to come up and hand over the delivery package to me, she spoke rudely and kept my order two floors down and sped away on her scooty. I kept waiting at the doorstep only to realise that she has already kept the order and gone!!!!!! Upon calling her thrice, she did not even bother to answer my phone. Disappointed and upset with the services provided by ‘blink it’!!!!!!

author: Apoorw Vikram
title: Unfair charges
review: Blinkit charges absurdly. They charge separately under 'Handling', 'Delivery' and 'Convenience.' Isn't handling and delivery part of the convenience that the app is delivering? Through these extra charges they put on average 10-20% load on customers' purses. It doesn't stop at that though. Blinkit also randomly applied surge charges. Right now, it's 3:48 am in the night. How can demand for products be so high at such an odd hour that they apply anywhere between 10-25% on average of total bill amount as extra surcharges? Eventually, the customers end up paying on average 15-40% extra on all their individual orders. That's much more than the labor and other fixed and variable costs they incur. Blinkit is basically pursuing ruthless profit through unfair application of extra charges that are totally unnecessary but the customers must pay. There are far better substitutes among its competition.

author: Ravi Kiran Varanasi
title: Worst service ever…don’t trust blink as they wont trust us.

Waste to buy a product in blink it…as the own team don’t has a bilef in customer and they wont cross check with team…the chain in the product itself missing …as i raised a concern to feedback team she is just telling sorry but she don’t want to solve the issue….as i requested her to call and check the cc tv footage and confirm that is he really checked the product and assigned to the customer or not …the feedback team tirupti is not interested to take the call…..and without any doing i just lost 1200 RS with in 20mins……worst worst worst blinkit service team and feedback team.

If you are not trusting the customer keep an open box delivery.

author: Mussu23
title: Want your enemies to suffer? Recommend this app to them
review:

O had placed my order twice but both time it was some issue or the other, either are too “busy” to take any order but still show that there app is available for ordering or after you have paid for your order they show some processing issue and say that they will refund the money after 3-5 days
If you can take the money so easily, then why does it take so long to return it 
And if there is some issues, they should not be able to deduct the money from the account . Not only did I waste my money but also my time. 
Would never recommend it to anyone ever

author: nothing betterr
title: Harassing delivery agent Mohammed
review: Blinkit delivery agent mohammed who delivered in sector 53 chandigarh on 2nd January misbehaved and harassed two ladies while delivering package and demanding an apology from them for giving him a slightly torn 10 rupee note which ensued an argument on not agreeing to apologising to him he called 10 other guys/men outside our house (all of them blinkit delivery agents) who intimidated us two women and charged towards us causing a huge scene and asking to be hit again and again ! We faced such harassment while we were alone at home ! The worst ever experience of my life with a delivery partner ! This person should be shunt out and those 10 others they are ganging up on women and spoiling the name of the company!

author: Sanjuuuuuuuuy
title: Trying to scam me everytime now
review:
I have been using blinkit from long, but in delhi. Now whenever i have ordered something from blinkit in sonipat, it is always with some issue. Most of the times items are missing from the order and i receive it without bill. Another time i order fresh paneer of 200 g but received even less than 100g. And complaint section is so slowww. I do not have this much time to have such patience and complaint everytime. This is such a scam, if i dont recheck my delivered order from my app, i ll be losing money with no goods received. 
Very much frustrateddd. Thinking of deleting the app and suggesting friends to do so as well.

author: Muskanguneet
title: Small request u guys won’t understand
review: First of all I m very disappointed by the customer service of your miss ayesha and miss rida both made fool out of me as I m new to blink it first I had order the blue colour lighter as I wanted to a gift for my brother on his birthday but they send me an green lighter first I have informed miss rida the support executive that I want blue lighter only but she said it’s on the way u can replace it with what u want I did the Same I replaced it but the replacement was also not what I wanted so I contacted the support executive again this time it was miss ayesha who was just apologetically saying not possible u have received the correct item etc but I haven’t received what was correct I have received the wrong one very bad service and pathetic customer service who just wanna make fool out of u after 2 years of using blink it this is what I got nothing but an disappointed from blink it shame

author: Shrill1991
title: Blinkit delivery boy :You need to get it by yourself:
review:
I’ve ordered some stuff from the app and merely 50 meter ahead of my building the delivery boy asked me to get the stuff as he can’t find my address. It was totally application fault that they have not pinned my address correctly and delivery guy even not bothered to ask address from someone or even bot asked me to guide the address but then also I’ve guided but he even not bothered to move from his location and he keeps telling me that I need to collect the stuff from him. Dear blinkit, I am not here to collect my stuffs from wherever you want, I am here to get my stuff delivered at my doorstep. If you cannot pay well your staff at least ask them to behave well. 

Uninstalling the app and I will make sure everyone I know will do the same and if they won’t do I will make them do the same and will never suggest to buy anything from your application.

author: ajaykrverma
title: Perishable products
review: I usually order 6-12 packs of Nestle tetra milk  packs each time I order so that they last for at least a month as the shell life is 6 months from packaging. Yesterday when I opened one box which was purchased by me 10 days earlier. The milk was of bad quality, having bad sour and spoiled. Grofers refused to return it saying they perishable items can be returned in 4 days only. This is nonsense. Tetra packs have a life of six months. We open it based on our need within the time allowed. Should we compulsory open all boxes within first four months only. Grofers terms and conditions are silent on this point. Grofers never told us about this condition to us neither at the time of signing nor at the time of placing order. The executive told a blatant lie on the matter. They even are unaware of Escalation matrix for handling  complaints of its customers and just ignore the facts giving reason of internal policy matter. Pathetic and frustrating.

author: Adarsh happy
title: Blinkit Is an Absolute Disaster – Worst Customer Service Ever!
review:
I am FURIOUS with Blinkit. This has been the most pathetic and infuriating experience I’ve ever had with any online platform.

I ordered OnePlus Buds, and guess what?
The box arrived COMPLETELY EMPTY. Literally NOTHING inside.
How does a company even deliver an empty box?!

Then I bought Kama Mehendi worth ₹2200, and that was another joke. The product looked FAKE, the box was air-blown, clearly tampered, while the rest of the packages were sleek. Anyone with eyes could tell something was wrong.

And when I raised a complaint, Blinkit’s so-called “customer support” did ABSOLUTELY NOTHING.
All they said was:
“We can’t return or replace the product.”

Seriously? You deliver EMPTY and FAKE items and then refuse to help?
What kind of scam service is this?

I begged to talk to someone senior.
They made me wait 12 HOURS before a lead even bothered to call — and even then, she had NO authority and NO solution. Total waste of time.

Let me say this LOUD AND CLEAR:
Blinkit is ONLY good for cheap daily groceries.
The moment your order goes above ₹1,000, you are on your own.
If something goes wrong (and trust me, it WILL), they WILL NOT help you. Their support team is powerless and hides behind useless scripts.

I’m done with this app.
NEVER buying high-value products from Blinkit again — and neither should you.

author: Ashwani JJJ
title: Bad experience with blinkit
review:
Earlier I was a great fan of grofers but recently it has been converted to blinkit, and i could see a great dip in the customer care. 
I have registered a complaint about a product for my order using chat they have registered the complaint but after that there no way to track.
Then after waiting for 2-3 days i myself called to customer care, they completely denied to process the complaint and said all items to be checked at doorstep delivery only later they can not do any replacement and refund. 
I will stop using this app from today onward will shift to big basket or big bazar which seems to be more customer friendly.

author: Karabi Basak
title: Poor quality non veg products
review:
I have been delivered with a stale chicken for the second time and when I reported that in the chat window the executive named Abdul without checking with me initiated replacement of the product which I didn’t  want. He called me and mentioned for refund but he without initiating the refund closed the matter/ticket. 
The Blinkit app is not at all user friendly. The chat window does not allow you to move forward without uploading the pic but it won’t allow you to take the pic from your mobile gallery. How long we can keep the stale chicken at home for sending images. I recommend not to buy any non veg item from Blinkit.

author: Subbujha
title: Blinkit: The Sneaky Snack Thief
review: I once thought Blinkit was a quick and easy way to grab a midnight snack. Little did I know, I'd stumbled into a well-oiled machine of sneaky charges and customer deception. They've mastered the art of the "surprise tip." You order a pack of chips, and suddenly, a ₹50 tip appears out of thin air. It's like a magician's trick, but instead of pulling a rabbit out of a hat, they're pulling money out of your wallet. Their customer support is as helpful as a chocolate teapot. They'll tell you to "just uncheck the tip next time," as if that's going to reverse the damage done. It's like they're saying, "Oops, our bad. Just pretend it never happened." With their sky-high delivery and handling charges, it's clear that Blinkit is more interested in lining their pockets than satisfying their customers. So, next time you're tempted to order a late-night snack, remember: Blinkit isn't just delivering food; they're delivering disappointment.

author: Virexk
title: 2 weeks expired bread loaf and unspeakably horrible Support
review: Got a 2 WEEKS expired bread load. Tried to get a refund, but they'd only offer replacement. Automated loop – "To regain your trust and confidence, we're offering you a replacement. a. Okay, got it b. Goo back to main menu" I had ordered the bread to eat immediately, didn't want to get a replacement. I instead ordered breakfast from a restaurant because I thought that'd be faster. Spent hours trying to speak to someone, but there was literally no way on the app to do that. Reluctantly opted for a replacement. That too didn't come for hours because I guess they didn't have fresh bread! Finally got to speak to someone on chat but that executive ended the chat abruptly! This after hours of trying to reach someone. Finally they cancelled the order themselves because what were they going to deliver? Got a refund after 8 hours of trying! Never again.

author: khan sector 57
title: One stop for all grocery needs
review:
Am happy to see that now I can order my salad and choose from the gourmet selection too! I am now buying most of my monthly grocery supplies here and am happy to note that with reasonable prices, I get a larger selection too. Earlier i was logging on to multiple e-commerce sites to buy the supplies. The only challenge is the desktop experience. I prefer logging at work day end to order supplies but the web interface either hangs or doesn’t work on the payment. Also the app and web don’t talk to each other sadly .
I rated the app when it was grofers… as Blinkit it’s a lifesaver app. Stationary items addition is really helpful…

author: Shraddha Rumalmath
title: My Daily Go-To App!
review:
Blinkit has truly become an essential part of my daily routine. Whether it's groceries, snacks, personal care items, or last-minute essentials, Blinkit delivers it all—super fast and super fresh. The delivery is always on time (often earlier than expected), and the packaging is neat and secure.

The app is user-friendly, the categories are well-organized, and the real-time tracking makes everything smooth. I especially love the deals and offers that make everyday purchases even more affordable.

Highly recommend Blinkit to anyone who values convenience, speed, and reliability. It has made my life so much easier—thank you, Blinkit!💛

author: D&DDHABA
title: Fantastic service… I love it

author: Rujaquar
title: Scammers
review:
This was a highly misleading product listing and a terrible customer support experience from Blinkit￼.

I ordered this charger thinking it was a normal plug-and-play car charger that fits into the cigarette lighter socket. However, after receiving it, I discovered it is actually a wired installation charger that requires fitting and wiring into the car dashboard.

This is a completely different type of product.

The issue is not that I “changed my mind.” The issue is that the listing presentation is misleading. The first image shown prominently looks like a standard car charger, while the important detail that it requires installation and wiring is hidden deeper in the images and not made clear upfront.

Any normal customer scrolling quickly would assume this is a regular USB car charger.

When I contacted support, instead of acknowledging the misleading listing, they refused to provide a refund and only offered a replacement of the exact same item which makes no sense because the product itself was not what was expected from the advertisement.

Their response felt robotic and dismissive:

* No accountability
* No attempt to understand the misleading listing
* No proper resolution
* Just repeating policy lines

Customers should be very careful before ordering electronics from this platform. If the product images and presentation are unclear or deceptive, you may end up stuck with something you never intended to buy.

I’m posting this review so others do not fall into the same situation. Transparency matters, and companies should clearly highlight important installation requirements instead of presenting the product like a normal plug-and-play accessory.

author: Bhani_man
title: Blinkit App Review
review:
The Blinkit app is a game changer when it comes to grocery shopping and delivering essentials. It offers a user-friendly interface that makes browsing products and placing orders incredibly simple. The variety of items available, from fresh produce to household supplies, ensures you get everything you need in one place.

One of the standout features is the super-fast delivery. Most orders arrive within 10-20 minutes, which is perfect for those last-minute needs. The delivery tracking is precise, and the delivery personnel are courteous. Payment options are flexible, with a seamless checkout process that supports various payment methods.

However, the app could improve by expanding its range of products in certain areas and ensuring product availability at all times. Occasionally, some items may be out of stock, which can be a bit inconvenient.

Overall, Blinkit is a must-have app for anyone looking to save time and get essentials delivered straight to their doorstep efficiently.

Blinkit has truly revolutionized grocery shopping, and I can’t imagine going back to regular store trips anymore!”

author: Raghu Ponnusamy
title: No RETURNS!
review:
I ordered the HP Keyboard K300 from Blinkit, but the quality was disappointing, so I decided to return it. To my surprise, the app doesn’t offer any option to initiate a return. Instead, you have to go through customer support — and even there, they’ve deliberately avoided providing a return option. It feels completely intentional.

When I contacted support using the option “item is damaged or not as expected,” a customer support executive called me. He informed me that he had no solution to offer at the moment. I clearly told him that I wanted to return the product and insisted they honor their return policy. However, he kept repeating the same scripted response like a robot and denied my right to return the item.

Be cautious when using Blinkit to buy expensive items or electronics — returns are practically impossible with these folks.

author: Parichauhan
title: Grocery service
review:
I am really disappointed with Blinkit’s service policy. They advertise “10-minute delivery,” which is great for urban areas, but what about people living in rural areas or small towns? Just because you can’t deliver in 10 minutes doesn’t mean you should avoid these areas completely.

People in villages also deserve access to quick and reliable services. Even if 10-minute delivery is not possible, you can still deliver within a few hours. Completely skipping these areas is unfair. We are willing to wait longer — we just want access to your service.

By not delivering to rural areas, Blinkit is missing a big opportunity and also limiting the choices of people like us, who are ready to order but have no option. Please consider expanding your service instead of ignoring these regions.

author: PKamble24

review:

author: Honest-reviewer-12345
title: Use Swiggy Instamart or Zepto or big basket but never Blinkit I repeat never
review:
Alright. You want the “delete-it-and-never-look-back” manifesto. Here it is.

⸻

Using Blinkit feels like paying a premium subscription to disappointment.

They sell you the dream: 10-minute delivery.
What you actually get is 10-minute anxiety followed by 30-minute confusion and a lifetime of mild resentment.

Items show “Available” — until you reach checkout. Then suddenly they vanish like your faith in the system. Discounts disappear. Fees appear. Handling fee. Small cart fee. Rain fee. Oxygen fee. By the time you pay, your ₹300 essentials have quietly evolved into ₹500 “why did I do this” purchases.

And let’s talk about quality.

You order fresh fruits. They arrive looking like they’ve survived three economic recessions.
You order bread. It expires tomorrow.
You order vegetables. They look emotionally unstable.

It’s not grocery delivery. It’s a blind trust exercise.

Customer support? Polite. Extremely polite. They’ll apologize so professionally you almost forget nothing will change. Refund? Maybe partial. Solution? Rare. Accountability? Mythical.

Blinkit doesn’t save time. It transfers the inconvenience from walking to a store into staring at your phone in disbelief.

If you enjoy:
	•	Paying more for less
	•	Surprise substitutions
	•	Checkout horror stories
	•	Produce that looks like it needs therapy

By all means, continue.

But if you prefer groceries without suspense, try Swiggy Instamart, Zepto, or BigBasket instead.

At least there, the only surprise should be how fast you finish unloading the bag — not what’s inside it.

Do yourself a favor.

Delete the app.
Free your wallet.
Protect your sanity.

It would be great if the development team could optimize the app to perform better on lower-bandwidth and higher-latency networks as well. Not everyone has access to stable 5G or Wi-Fi all the time. Apart from this issue, the service is good, but I hope the developers address this network compatibility problem in a future update.

author: Meo jfdekn

review:

author: Deeejjaay

author: Karan Parikh 33
title: Extremely disappointed with Blinkit.
review:
My recent experience was unacceptable. The delivery executive falsely claimed that I had cancelled my order. When I asked for proof of cancellation, he immediately hung up the call instead of providing any explanation.

I then contacted customer support. The representative offered “free delivery” on a second attempt, but I had already paid the delivery charges for the original order that was never delivered. How is it considered free when I have already paid from my own pocket for a service that was not provided?

This is not the first issue I’ve faced. In a previous order, I received milk with the expiry details wiped off. When we boiled it, the milk was spoiled and unusable. That raises serious concerns about quality control and customer safety.

If this is happening to me, I wonder how many customers across India are facing similar issues. Small charges and poor service may seem insignificant individually, but when multiplied across millions of orders, the impact is huge.

After these experiences, I have decided not to support Blinkit anymore and will encourage others to explore reliable local stores and businesses instead.

Support local businesses 👍🏼

author: Niku12345)(
title: Blinkit selling electronic item and it is doing unfair practice
review:
Subject: Complaint Against Blinkit’s Return Policy for Electronic Items

Dear Sir/Madam,

I would like to raise a complaint regarding the return policy of Blinkit, which I found to be extremely unfair and inconvenient for customers.

I recently purchased an electronic item from Blinkit, but due to size-related issues, the product did not suit my requirement. Unfortunately, I was disappointed to learn that Blinkit does not accept returns or exchanges for such genuine concerns.

For online purchases, customers rely entirely on product descriptions and images, which may not always give a complete understanding of the actual size and usability. In the case of electronic items, size is a very important factor, and denying returns on this basis puts customers at a disadvantage.

This rigid policy reflects a lack of customer-centric approach and reduces trust in the platform. A flexible return or exchange option for unused products in original condition should be provided, especially for valid issues like size mismatch.

I request Blinkit to kindly reconsider and improve its return policy to ensure better customer satisfaction and fairness.

I hope my concern will be addressed seriously.

author: HBATRA44
title: Disappointed with Blinkit’s Policy on Substandard Products
review:
I’ve been a regular user of Blinkit for the convenience, but lately their quality control and customer service policies have been seriously disappointing.

On multiple occasions, I’ve received stale or near-expiry groceries, damaged packaging, or products that clearly don’t meet quality standards. When I try to raise the issue through their support, the response is either dismissive or a flat-out refusal to offer any refund or replacement, citing “policy.”

It’s unacceptable for a platform that promises freshness and quality to wash their hands off when they deliver subpar items. If you’re delivering essentials, especially perishables, there has to be accountability. What’s worse is the lack of transparency — nowhere do they clearly explain this anti-consumer policy before purchase.

review: Order over 199 to avoid a standard 30 rupee delivery fee. Order over 500 to avoid a surge fee that’s usually 30-50 rupees. review:

author: vasu.agarwal96
title: Unreliable and cheats
review:

My point is why this app is accepting order in the first place, when they are not sure if they’d be able to deliver, that too when provided 15 days. And why blaming it on lockdown when even local vendors are delivering well.

The app is not trustworthy, don’t waste your time, money and effort here, and don’t get stuck in begging for refund situation, specially in already tense situation. Figure out a way to get groceries locally.

My advise: Simply don’t trust this app, delete it and get rid of hassle.

author: Harsh1999G
title: Stop fooling your customers please
review:

author: Spider monkey 🙈🙉🙊

review:
