author: mumtaz k
title: Cashback takes forever to reach my wallet (it's not a real cashback)
review: I made a purchase and a transaction of 632rs after 2 weeks and I'm still awaiting cashback in my Grofers wallet to make my next purchase, which means I'm in control of their availability. The Grofers frying that was half the amount of 349rs is in orange cash where I cannot really use it, "at all". The customer service has been asking to wait and wait and wait, for 24-48hrs to another 24hrs and so on. The delivery of the frying pan was wrong ...they delivered a tawa and then took it back and made me a refund at first. After acknowledging their mistake, then the reorder on my behalf. And, I don't receive a cashback as yet. Im tired of messaging on "can we help" and now realise it's a scam. Cashback isn't really cashback!

author: Shaila Anwer
title: Order Review
review: I have ordered a power bank from blinkit app , at first they provided me wrong product, after chatting one hour to customer support, later they provided me replacement and the power bank was damaged it was not getting charged the customer support wasted my 1.5 hours on chat and later came with a resolution that she can’t provide replacement or refund , later after connecting with the manager the team couldn’t help me with return , truly disappointing experience I have been using Blinkit from long but the customer service is decreasing now and the customer policy is also very cheap, they didn’t provided me any resolution and asked me to keep the damage product which costed me 1520, blinkit ypu should return and provide me compensation and refund and apologise for this behaviour.

author: Fraud Happened
title: Fraud happen with me
review: I just ordered one kurta, which I returned due to size issues, and when the delivery boy picked up the package, he said that the amount would reflect in your account in an hour, but it didn't happen. The worst part is you just can't connect with them; their chat system is so frustrating that in the end you have to leave no matter whether your issue gets resolved or not. As in my case, when they wanted to pick the return, they just called me nonstop. Including the customer executive and delivery boy. Feeling like a fraud happened with me. If brands like Blinkit do such things, I just can't imagine it. To senior authorities out there, please look into the matter, as it takes years to earn goodwill for a brand but can lose it within a fraction of time. KINDLY HELP!!

author: alisha9299
title: Rude behaviour
review:
Delivery boy Ramprasadi was very rude and arrogant while he came to drop the order. As I’ve already set my payment option to cash on delivery while I gave him 200 (total charge was 138) he was not able to give me 62 rupees back as he was not carrying any change in cash and insisted me to pay him by Google pay. He went outside the society to get change of 200 which I paid him while returning back he needs to pay me 62 he paid me 60 and after then started arguing that I went outside for your 130 rupees order and my petrol was wasted just because of you. 
Blinkit it’s a humble request to take care of your customer as these kind of workers are spoiling ur brand image & I’ll not be using ur app and even I’ll share this to my friends & family too. 

Really a very pathetic experience.

author: Bbhaski
title: Bad and worst’s service
review: I placed order for fruits I was waiting waiting finally I got a sms says cancelled I have paid the amount address and location map is given I spite of this order is cancelled in the map it’s Showing 2mts it will reach u but order cancelled and saying 2 to 5 days your money will credited to my account I cam to know this is kind of business they will take the order once they the money they will cancel the order if they do for 1000 orders 5 days they get for very good money pls do not go this kind website for placing any kind of order Thanks BHASKER

author: Anil0405
title: Poor customer care response
review: This is the third time i facing issue with Blinkit. This time i had ordered some grocery half an hour back despite the expected delivery time was 8-10 minutes. After 30 minutes when i text to customer support i got reply that someone picked my order and he is in the way. Blinkit store is half KM away from my home. Even after 10 minutes there is no movement in driver status in the tracking and i am unable to chat further in the chat box since the reply option is not there. Finally the driver reached to my place and asking me come down to pick my order. I am at third floor and my left hand is fractured. The delivery person was so rude and left my 10kg packet down the building. Somehow i managed to take my packets in my house. Poor service.

author: im a bosss 😎
title: No title but bad review
review:
It was Sunday 7:30 pm I have ordered one ice creame brick it tells to take high demand surges charges still I have paid the money before delivery 
It tells your delivery will come in 13 min so I waited till 10 min then I have opened blink it and it shows that my order is on the way then I waited some minute after some time I have opened blink it on my mobile i opened blink it at 8:10 pm it was showing that  you order is cancelled and they returned my money 
Please don’t do whith us we are beleaving you that our delivery will come safely but your cancelling,  that’s not nice.

author: PreetiNathani
title: Could do a better job, once you have competition you will die
review: Pathetic service, hopeless delivery partners. Blinkit can be better, work harder. You are a delivery partner and charge for delivery but at least make sure you partner with ethical people. Products worth 10 k are easily being ordered every month by me, but what I get is stale products, damaged packs, old unclean packs, etc. And nothing much can be done by you guys thereafter. Why should this happen in first place. Have some quality parameters. And you just drop off the stuff openly and take back your bags.

author: sapns.dp
title: Very frustrating experience
review:
We order few items, we showed half and hour delivery. After an hr when we check we were updated that order has been delivered. I went to check if the package was left a doorway. But nothing was there, hence tried calling customer support, but it was frozen and only chat option was open, so send mg through that, but every time it said the package delivered. Normally in past when the package was delivered the delivery guy would ask us to open the package and would ask to separate the product packet wise, take a photo and then leave.
This time we have not received any, chat is saying goods delivered and case close… this is very frustrating..
I did not want to give any star but do not have any option so gave 1 star.
I and deleting this app

author: Geetha AC
title: Fake product received
review: I ordered the Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser from Blinkit, trusting that I would receive a genuine product, but unfortunately, what I received appears to be fake. The packaging looks different from the original, cleanser is too liquidy and the product smelled unusual and not like the real Cetaphil cleanser that I have used before. This is very disappointing and concerning, especially for a skincare product that goes directly on the face. I have acne-prone skin, and using counterfeit products can cause serious issues. Blinkit needs to verify its sellers and ensure product authenticity before shipping to customers. I have raised a complaint, and I hope Blinkit takes quick action to investigate this and issue a refund/replacement. Genuine products are a basic expectation, especially from a reputed app like Blinkit.

author: C R Park
title: I was on chat
review:
I was in chat with customer care and customer care guy again and again was asking whether I need refund and I confirmed too and after waiting I start doing some other work.  When I open the app around couple of days for ordering something, there was no refund.  I again contacted the customer care and got the same reply weather I want refund…
I again opted for the refund and got the reply as my window is closed.  Refund was of Rs. 100 and customer support wanted me to keep on chatting and forget other works.   
Unacceptable

author: roopa sheee
title: Best blink it
review:
It’s really worth buying products from Blinkit! Every time I order from them, I’m completely satisfied.
But once, I ordered from Big Basket, and honestly, just looking at the package irritated me. The delivery was terrible even if they give offers or freebies, I wouldn’t want to buy again.

Blinkit’s packaging and delivery are just perfect totally worth it!
I’ve been using the app for months now, mainly for quick cooking essentials and coconut water. Even the tender coconut feels truly fresh, and the product packaging is always impressive. Highly recommend it!

author: romannumber
title: Undelivered order and poor customer service
review: I will not even give 1 star because of the experience i had with delivery and customer support. I placed an order in which item were missing for which i raised query and had terrible experience. I was told that their person has confirmed that he delivered the product but in conference he only accepted that item went out of stock because of which it wasn’t delivered. Firstly no trust is shown to customer, we wouldn’t raise concern if it was delivered and after having an argument for about 10min , the solution which was given was a conference call with delivery guy . And one suggestion I would like to guy , if any item is rescheduled for delivery, kindly proceed it with customer concent . This is highly inappropriate that a person is coming so late for delivery.

author: Ariana3028
title: Do not install, the worst experience.
review: My first order I’ve placed on this app, I ordered only 2 small items. And they didn’t send me the more expensive item. They sent me some other random item. When I checked and told the delivery partner that my order was wrong he said he had nothing to do with it and left. I’ve tried over 15 times to get in touch with customer help and they don’t even open a conversation with me to address the issue. I have no one that’s addressed my issue at all and my money’s wasted. Such a bad experience.

author: Ivar Ch
title: Worst service, not recommended at all
review:
I literally never wanted to write anything bad about Blinkit, because I used to believe it’s easier and helpful app until it has change my mindset totally, as I had placed an order for 3items and I had paid many charges like handling and delivery charges, however my 1 item was missing and when I informed the delivery partner he literally said “Mai kya karu” rude!!!!! And also vendors not checking before handing over the orders and when I raised this query customer service(Naina) said they will not refund my partial chargers of handling and delivery charges only the missing items money will be refunded and forcefully they did. 
This is really annoying when you are in need of something and that thing is only missing from your item. Hopeless Blinkit!

author: Mur4gan
title: Worst Experience with Blinkit
review:
I faced an issue with the Blinkit app, and they’re refusing to take responsibility or provide a solution. Here’s what happened: I placed a birthday gift order for my friend, who lives far away. During the transaction, I encountered a payment error, so I switched the payment method and placed the order again. I exited the app after completing the process.

Later, I was surprised to receive the product at my address instead of my friend’s. Upon checking, I found that the accepted order, which was processed successfully, had my address, while the failed payment order still showed my friend’s address with its order ID. This clearly indicates a glitch in the app, but Blinkit is refusing to acknowledge the issue. Their lack of accountability is incredibly frustrating.

author: dream_destroyer
title: Unbelievably Super Fast
review: Luck thing that their warehouse is just beside our society. I literally get things within 15 mins at my home. Not only groceries but also other items like gifts, electronics items, etc within 15 mins. Important thing is their print out service. A lot of ppl are still not aware about this, so you guys need better advertisements for this service too. Improvements: With printouts you should also accept groceries. I tried this but I can only order print outs and then next order for groceries. Can’t club it.

author: Sanhydro
title: Very foul mouthed delivery partner
review:
Today I was literally taken aback by the very bad behaviour of your delivery person. I and my family have been getting regular orders from your app. Previously also few persons had problems with pin pointing the correct address but they had the patience to listen and follow directions on phone.
For the first time in life I felt humiliated by a delivery boy. 
Please train these people to behave, because they represent you in the society. I will think twice now before getting anything from Blinkit,
I would prefer rather my local Kirana Shop.

author: Haihayvanshi
title: Problems and merits
review: Everything about this app is five star but the people who bring the Delivery on. COD never has change for 500 and in starting it is okay but as a time passes, it becomes quite a headache. If you’re ready to give 500 for a 470 parcel. They are ready to take the ₹30 that they owe but if you have ₹141 parcel and you have the change but you do not have one rupees, they are not even going to take that because they need that one rupee to and they expect us to give us ₹30. They never carry our changes. There is the reason because COD is brought so that we can even get change the only and the biggest problem with blanket is it does not haveservice of giving change according to its parcel

author: NiharikaLuthra
title: Best platform for immediate deliveries
review: Have been ordering from grofers for some time now and never have been disappointed so far. I really could not understand how are they managing deliveries in such a short span of time. I still remember my first experience for ordering from Grofers. Its like within a blink of time my groceries were delivered .. Perfectly named Blink it .. Kudos to the whole team .. You are doing a very good job for making our lives better in pandemic situations.. I really dont have to worry for anything now because i know it will be delivered within a blink .. 👍👍

author: Parul Nigam
title: Pathetic product quality
review: Dear Team Blinkit It is very sad to inform you that though you are delivering product in 9 minutes, you are not at all able to provide us worth of our money. We are not receiving quality products the products getting delivered are damaged and of very poor quality. Today I ordered 3 packet milk which is curdled. Further I ordered Maggie family pack which is completely crushed and broken. When I approached customer care the response i get was you have already used  and disposed off the product keep the product as it is. What kind of response is this? We have paid the price and quality check is your problem not ours. Don’t just make money without offering good products just for the sake of profit. This will not take you to the long run

author: Sham1712
title: Bad service
review: Had a very bad experience. I was told the order is delivered but I didn’t receive it. Tried calling delivery partner but his phone was unavailable. I asked my security guard and he said that the delivery man kept the parcel down and left. I was not called to inform of the same but just got the notification that it is delivered. The point of the app is for door to door service. If i had to go down to pick the parcel, i wud have gone to my local grocery store. How did i benefit from your service if i had to go down and get it myself. The customer service told me i cant be compensated for my inconvenience because I received the parcel. But did I receive it at home? The answer is no… not worth the download. Instead ur local grocer will send something without charging delivery fee and faster.

author: abiarusomas
title: Blinkit is doing wonders
review: (Grofers) so called Blinkit is doing wonderful job, before I keep my mobile down after the order is placed, it is reaching me. Most of the items are available, making our job easy. If you could avail some offers on leading credit cards that would be an added advantage. We were using BB earlier but switched to Blinkit before a month, so far we’ve placed minimum 5 to 6 orders, all were delivered on time. Very much happy about the delivery and the products. Cheers to the team who is making it possible for the end customers.

author: Aditipitti
title: Best application ever made
review: Okay genuinely I’m giving this review of this app is a lifesaver who ever made this idea of making this application is the greatest person. Last day. It was my niece birthday and I really forgot her gift that God grace. This app comes handy and I just fixed giving gifts her in the last moment. Oh my God, this app was a save a must try but yeah you should open more often stores in many more cities because their stores and the services are limited available and limited cities. So please mind opening the store in all over India please

author: Paruuulll
title: Fraud
review: I ordered a product with order products , but a different product was sent to me. The delivery partner asked me to either take the complete product or cancel. Firstly i refused to cancel and demanded the product i ordered. But on his request i cancelled . Then after few days i again placed n order, and same thing was repeated. N when i asked for my product they cancelled the complete order without my consent. N when i resisted they wrote the order was cancelled due to technical issue. Both my payments are stuck. Poor customer support. Very rude. I ll never again order from blinkit. They should know that there is no monopoly in this business. N they can’t stuck customer money just like that. If the product is not available, it should be marked unavailable.

author: Lost_boy_1190
title: Worst Experience Ever with Blinkit – Don’t Waste Your Money!
review:
I’m genuinely frustrated and disappointed with Blinkit. I have been noticing it from long time that they send products that are close to expiry  and some of them even looked used, especially perfumes and deodorants! It felt like I was sent those tester pieces you see lying in malls for people to try.

And the worst part? Their customer care is absolutely useless. Don’t even bother trying to contact them, they’ll do nothing to help you. Once your order is placed, you’re stuck with it, no matter the condition. There’s no exchange, no replacement, no accountability.

This is pure cheating, If you care about your money, do not buy perfumes, cosmetics, or any near-expiry products from Blinkit. They are clearly dumping old or used stock on customers.

author: shweta416
title: Worst app
review:
This app is an absolute scam! The delivery partner took ₹1310 in CASH from me, but on their own app, he marked it as “Paid Online” without my consent. On my side, it shows as online paid, but the refund went straight to the delivery partner instead of me!

I’ve been chasing my own money for 5–6 days, repeatedly following up with their so-called support executives, and honestly, they are completely useless. None of them understand a single thing I’m saying! Every time, they keep repeating the same nonsense — “You paid via UPI… you paid via QR…” when I clearly tell them I paid CASH.

When I finally asked for compensation for all this harassment and inconvenience, the support agent shamelessly disconnected the chat! They pretend to “care” but don’t do a single thing to actually help. If they had verified the UPI ID in the first place, my refund would’ve been processed instantly, but no — they keep passing the blame.

This is the WORST app ever. Unprofessional, irresponsible, and untrustworthy. I’ve lost my money, wasted my time, and received zero help. I will never order anything from this app again, and I strongly warn everyone to stay away from this pathetic service!

author: Sandhya upreti
title: Unsupportive customer care executives
review:
I am writing to express my disappointment regarding a recent experience with your service. I mistakenly ordered an item and requested a replacement or return. However, your team repeatedly referred to a return policy that claims certain items cannot be returned.

What I find frustrating is the inconsistency—on previous occasions, I received poor-quality products due to errors on your end, and the returns were accepted. This time, despite my genuine concern, I am being denied support, which feels like a clear double standard.

Moreover, the customer support team has not been helpful or empathetic during this interaction, which has only added to my dissatisfaction. I no longer feel confident recommending this app to anyone due to this experience.

author: Bhupendra Gupta 21
title: Last time my order is delayed for 45 minutes and now today after 35 minutes my order cancelled
review: Last time my order is delayed for 45 minutes and now today after 35 minutes my order cancelled automatically is thi a service u guys providing I am very disappointed today again, if you guys not providing order on time then don’t took the orders , in my area if I am going outside at 12 AM also then I will get everything from market also but u guys have worst service.. I live in south Delhi . Sometime your delivery partner are asking for extra money also and now you cancelled my order also , very bad service provider and customer service is also sending auto generated message support system is also worst today I am very disappointed..

author: anubhasy
title: Superb service and user experience
review:
I don’t generally write review for apps but over the past 2 years Blinkit has impressed me over and over again with its agility in responding to customer needs.

They modified their product packing to reduce waste, the app interface is user centric makes ordering a breeze, and the customer support is prompt, efficient, and professional. Blinkit also has an extensive variety of products, including some niche products like Lotus biscuits, automatic home aur freshener, etc. 

Overall, an impressive app and smooth experience.

author: Sabkz
title: Seamless app, wide variety, not the best fresh veg
review: Very easy to use app and excellent UX! Great prices and very easy to navigate. Wide variety of items. I find their packaging far better than other quick comm brands and the items are also very clean. Household items are high quality - for example stainless steel items and cookware. However fresh veg and fruit is a struggle… I’ve got damaged items or poor quality often. So, better to buy that in person. But rest of the items are really good and super convenient to order from Blinkit.

author: Shreelakshmi Agrawal
title: Worst delivery service!
review:
Unprofessional and inefficient are the only words I have for your customer service.
I placed an order last week, it showed me the earliest delivery slot for exactly after a week but i still chose it because I am a regular customer and I always shop from Grofers. After waiting for one week, on 10th May when my order was supposed to be delivered. I get a notification at 8, saying Order out for delivery. At 10:30 I get a notification saying My order has been rescheduled for 17th May! After 1 more week.
First of all, I am the customer. The order is my need. I am the one who has the right to reschedule it. And if you have an issue and cannot deliver it on that day, it’s still understandable. But delivering it after 1 week? 
FYI, there are many more apps that provide the same service. A customer is not dying to be loyal to you that they will wait for you for 2 weeks. 
Additionally, their customer service does not answer 1 single call. They don’t reply to 1 single feedback email. They don’t even give an explanation for their mistakes, let alone making up for it to retain the customer. 
Will never use your service ever again, let alone recommending it to someone.

author: AyeshaR009
title: Love love love
review:
I want to share a story, but it’s much to type. I love you guys, delivery in 8 mins so apt, and the wide range of products you have; my mind is blown. You have spoilt me, if I don’t have something instantly I don’t want it anymore. Even Amazon’s one day delivery feels like forever to wait! I love you, BlinkIt! I am so proud to be an Indian and be able show off to outsiders that we have door step delivery in 8 mins, almost anything we want! Which takes them an entire drive to a grocery store. I bought EarPods, Skin care, dog food, junk, my gosh… 

 Faithful customer,
 A.R

author: neils2012
title: Very bad customer service
review:
I’ve used Blinkit for a while, but my recent experience with their customer service has been incredibly disappointing. The service itself is quick, but when issues arise—like missing items, wrong deliveries, or refund requests—it’s nearly impossible to get timely help.  

The customer support is **horrible**—no response for hours, automated replies that don’t solve the problem, and no direct way to speak to a real person. Even the in-app chat feels useless, as agents either take forever to respond or close the ticket without resolving anything.  

If Blinkit wants to retain customers, they **urgently** need to improve their support system. Right now, the lack of accountability and poor assistance makes me reconsider using the app again.

author: Dr Tanuja
title: Repeated service issues
review: It is so expensive!! There are too many hidden charges. Quality is a issue. Sometimes the vegetables would be spoiled or wilted, the batter would be so unclean on the exterior. It sure does come fast , but as all things quick, quality takes a huge beating. Also if Blinkit cannot manage the cash on delivery option, why does it have to be placed as an option! Overall I would go back to my regular shopping, instead of blinking it! And many of the people I know have voiced the same!

author: 0*😞BAD
title: Refund of money due to damaged vegetables
review: U have send 5 rotten n damaged vegetables n the video I shared but ur robot says u will refund for only 2 products but why do u send rotten vegetables v have trusted Blinkit even when big  bazaar n now Zepto but blink it is no more recommendable but u havnt refunded as well as v cannot further complain as options r not there ..plz give us a live chat in customer care service or a customer call provision ..my issue is related to the 2nd November order kindly refund my vegetables money in my wallet or replace them ..since I was travelling didn’t have the time to follow up

author: Rashmi-13
title: Can we give zero star rating?
review: I have been ordering from blinket since a very long time and was really happy with their services until today. I ordered egg tray on 7th sept and kept it in store since I was going to use it later , didn’t get time to consume them tbh. But when I opened the tray today eggs were all rotten and foul smell was coming out of it. I crushed one of them some black liquid came out. Obviously I would expect a replacement or refund since eggs don’t go bad in this time period. Blinket support executive told me we cannot initiate refund or replacement since it’s been 7 days which infact today is the 7th day and me not being aware about their policy. I am sorry but really disappointed with your service blinket. Would definitely switch to different app for my groceries now.

author: ANeladri
title: Cheating customers with missing order items and expired products with no return policy
review: Cheating customers with missing order items and expired products with no return policy. One of the items in the orders were missing, and when I noticed it and notified Blinkit customer care they took a lot of time to confirm and deliver it again. Most importantly one of the ordered items were looking of very low quality, covered in so much dirt and it looked very badly handled. I wanted to return the product but Blinkit customer care team denied it saying no return policy. How a customer consume a product which is of poor quality and dirty. They are literally cheating the customers in the name of no return policy. And customer care team is very bad that they are not even trained to handle the issues.

author: AmolDalal
title: So fast that everything else is less important
review: We have fruit vendor in our society. On occasion of Ekadashi we wanted apples urgently to prepare apple smoothie. However when I went downstairs I came to know that our fruit vendor doesn't have apples today. From there itself I placed order on BlinkIt for apples. And within 3-4 minutes of me reaching home I got apple delivery from BlinkIt. To my surprise the quality of apples was far better than that of our society vendor and pricing is appropriate. What else one can desire more for?  So happy with the Service.

author: vidushi@chandigarh
title: Order items missing!!!App showing cashback..not given
review:
I am a loyal customer of blinkit/ grofers but you just lost me. I ordered today & prepaid for lemons which were not delivered by your delivery man. By the time, I checked it, he had already left. His name on the app was coming as farhan. Also 25/- cashback was applied but didn’t reflect in the bill. So i have been robbed by you for 50 rs on a bill of 766/- rs. Your customer support conveniently has no option to address this concern. I hope that some one from your customer care will contact me. Otherwise i m deleting this app forever . I would have rated you as negative star but again there’s no option!
PS: i was just told that delivery man had hidden his face behind a helmet & was laughing. Don’t know whether its the parent company or the delivery boy!!

author: Neha Mohanta
title: Worst service
review:
I had ordered for 6 items including an ice cream bar. It took more than one hour to deliver the order. My order was rescheduled because the delivery boy said he cannot deliver my order since it’s far away, he mentioned a different address than the one I gave. I told him repeatedly that that wasn’t true and I am seeing my home address in the order details. He disagreed and behaved rudely and asked me to cancel the order. As he cannot deliver. After I refused he told me to give manual instructions to reach my address from the store. I was not aware of the store location. He did not know how to navigate using google maps. He disconnected the call and I had to wait for more than an hour to get the items delivered. 

I tried reaching out to the customer support. And to my surprise the support executive was super late. Her name was Shefali and she did not provide me the reason for such misbehaviour of the delivery executive. Also, she did not resolve or try to deliver my order faster. I waited for more than an hour. 

Worst customer service and delivery experience. I regularly use swiggy insta mart and they deliver my order within minutes. Blinkit representatives harass customers.

To my surprise the items were not packed as well. I had ordered ice cream and it had totally melted as no ice packs were provided. The delivery boy gave me the packing bag and I had to hold it while he placed my items in the bag. I cannot write enough how utterly disappointed I am. Total negative experience and I wish I could give less than one star. 

I am recommending everyone to use swiggy insta mart instead of blinkit. 

I will never use blink it and will recommend my friends to not use it as well

* Rude behaviour by delivery personnel and the customer executive. A big no no to blinkit

author: Er Vivek Sonawane
title: Very shameful and very poor costumer care very bad experience
review:
My experience with Blinkit support has been extremely disappointing. I received a Hershey’s Chocolate Spread in a damaged and unsealed condition, which is a serious food safety concern.

Despite reporting the issue, there has been no proper resolution. The damaged product has not been picked up, and the refund has not been processed. Instead of resolving the complaint promptly, I have been kept waiting without any meaningful update.

This level of service is unacceptable. I expected better quality control and customer support from Blinkit. Unless this issue is resolved immediately, I will have no option but to escalate the matter through the appropriate consumer grievance channels and reconsider using Blinkit’s services in the future.

author: SivaNageswararao
title: Doorstep Delivery Promise Not Being Followed in Hyderabad
review:
Very disappointed with Blinkit service in Hyderabad. Delivery personnel rarely come to the doorstep, even when I clearly select and mention “Leave at Door.” Instead, they keep calling and asking customers to come outside and collect the order.

I have already raised this complaint three times, but nothing has changed. Every time, customer support responds saying that delivery partners will be trained, yet the same issue continues to happen repeatedly.

As a customer, I expect the service promised by the platform. If doorstep delivery is offered, it should be followed consistently. Due to the lack of improvement despite multiple complaints, I strongly do not recommend Blinkit in Hyderabad until they address this issue seriously.

author: Ashishthunder
title: Don’t want to order due to surge charge.
review:
Whenever I am trying to order from the app it is always asking for surge charge regardless of time. If the demand for Blinkit is high then I think it is a good thing and just due to high demand surge charge should not be taken from other customers.
By the was it is not possible that the demand is always high so stop faking the high demand and ask surge charge.
I have checked and observed that even early morning and late night also the app is showing surge change. Seriously you think there are soo many people’s are ordering from blink even surge charge is applicable and not using other apps where there are no surge change.
Stop faking the high demand and stop surge charge.

author: Sarfi0
title: Urgent Complaint Regarding Delivery Executive Misconduct and Potential Scam Attempt
review:
Over the past few weeks, we have observed a disturbing pattern where Blinkit delivery executives insist on taking customers’ phones under the pretext of adding the delivery address. This behavior is not only highly unprofessional but also raises grave concerns about data privacy, security, and potential scam activities.

Today, this crossed a line. A delivery executive outright refused to deliver the order when my friend declined to hand over their phone. What’s worse, the executive became extremely rude, aggressive, and threatening. He used intimidating language including, “Jo ukhadna hai ukhad lo, nahi dera mai order” — a statement that is both unacceptable and alarming.

Such behavior is intolerable. As a customer, we expect professionalism, courtesy, and respect — not harassment or threats.

author: Cookieeeee@012
title: Extra charges
review:
I used to choose Blinkit for convenience, but the increasing number of extra charges is making the service difficult to justify. Apart from delivery fees, customers are now charged handling charges, high-demand fees, and other additional costs that often make the final bill significantly higher than expected.

While I understand that businesses need to cover operational costs, adding multiple charges on top of product prices feels excessive and lacks transparency. The convenience of quick delivery is being overshadowed by the feeling of being nickel-and-dimed on every order.

I would appreciate clearer pricing and a reduction in these unnecessary surcharges. Until then, it's becoming harder to see the value in using the service regularly.

author: Shahida from blinkit
title: Poor quality and extremely bad service by blinkit support (shahida)
review:
I ordered a tripod with a ring light from Blinkit and had a terrible experience. The product arrived in a damaged box and looked like it had already been used before delivery. It did not match the images shown on the app, and the build quality was extremely poor.

The tripod parts were loose and unstable no matter how much I tightened them. There was also no instruction manual provided. When I placed my iPhone on it, the stand could not even support the phone’s weight properly, causing it to fall and crack the back glass of my phone.

What disappointed me even more was Blinkit’s customer support. Despite explaining the issue multiple times, the support team kept repeating the same responses instead of actually helping or accepting responsibility. Even after requesting a refund and return, there has been no proper resolution.

I specifically spoke with a customer care executive named Shahida, but the issue still remained unresolved. This entire experience felt like a complete waste of money and time. I expected much better quality and accountability from Blinkit.

author: Naaeha
title: Extremely Poor Experience
review:
Absolutely unacceptable service. I ordered 5 items and one item (coconut) was missing from the order. This is basic order handling and still it wasn’t done properly.
What’s even worse is that this isn’t the first time I’ve faced issues. Earlier also I ordered the Urban Yog hair removal kit and had problems with that order as well. It feels like mistakes are becoming a regular thing with Blinkit.
The most frustrating part is the “Help” option in the app. Every time I try to contact support, the same automated message pops up saying chat support is hampered due to surge in queries. If support is always unavailable, then what is the point of having a Help section at all?
Customers should not have to run behind emails just to report missing items from their order. This shows a serious lack of accountability and customer care.
Missing items, repeated order issues, and no proper support — this completely defeats the purpose of using a quick commerce app.
Very disappointed with this experience. If this continues, customers will simply stop trusting and using this platform.

author: Guddddooo
title: Not Using Blinkit Again After This Experience
review:

author: Avimas993

review:

Then, they ran a promotion that promised a free box of kaju katli if I spent over a thousand rupees. I met the requirement, but they didn’t deliver the kaju katli. Instead, they offered me flight coupons – which is ridiculous. Why would I want flight coupons from a grocery app?

My third issue was with a toy I ordered. The quality was terrible, and when I requested a refund, they refused, only offering a replacement. To make matters worse, they set up the replacement on their terms without asking about a convenient time or location for me. The customer support is the worst – they take ages to respond, and when they finally do, their solutions are inadequate.

Overall, this has been one of the worst app experiences I’ve had. I’m done with Blinkit’s poor support and unreliable service.

author: fragilama
title: Suffering aka Blinkit
review: If anyone is seeking an unpleasant experience, you are welcome to engage with Blinkit. The service appears misleading, attracting urban customers with a 10-minute delivery promise. However, when issues arise or complaints are raised, the customer faces significant challenges. Blinkit seems impervious to feedback, persisting in defending their product despite potential concerns or mismatches. To them, a customer spending 50k per month is merely inconsequential and unworthy of raising concerns about a product from their warehouse. I found myself compelled to keep a mistakenly ordered product valued at 1000 rupees, with Blinkit refusing to facilitate a return. Additionally, I had to use a food item (Basmati rice), only to discover post-cooking that the quality did not align with the claims made on the product page.

author: red chillies
title: Poor Damage & Delivery policy
review: The product was delivered in the damaged condition, the delivery person also recognised the fact and took the product back post some conversation with his backend team. review: I had ordered for cooking oil but wrong item was delivered. I immediately contacted support and got them to agree to replace the item. The replaced item was also not what I had ordered. I asked them to refund to my original source of payment. But for this they want me to call in the next 24 hours and lodge another complaint or else I will lose my money. author: AjayGupta327
title: Amazing delivery time
review: It’s amazing how fast this service is. Today the order time was 8 minutes but my order came I 5 minutes. I just hope riders are not putting them and others at risk through fast driving. I hope the company is focused on this aspect and is also taking care of its riders. From a customer perspective, I am delighted. It’s almost magical how you order something and it shows up on your door so soon. The items are limited as of now but I am hopeful they will increase once the model is successful.

author: Dr Sameena Kausar

review:
The words cannot express how grateful I am for the Super Heros of Blinkit. In fact this app has saved my day many a times. It has become a habit now. author: SwapnilKurve

author: Iqlash

author: Agarwal08

title: Flawed App and Exorbitant pricing
review: The app first tells you that the order will be delivered in 8 minutes. And then it tells you it is sorry as it cannot find a delivery partner. The order did not arrive even after 20 minutes! I have NEVER seen that happen on Zepto. They will tell you upfront it will take longer and mostly stick to their commitment in delivery time. Moreover the costs on Blinkit are ALWAYS higher that Zepto for stuff which don’t have a fixed MRP. Example: Yelakki Bananas are Rs. 75/- on Zepto and Rs. 93 on Blinkit for 500 gms. That’s a clear rip off!

author: Asdhjklluhnng
title: Expire products
review:
Today in the morning i ordered  milk from blinkit and when i boiled it the milk was splitting(milk curding) as the milk was of 4 june which was over date please take action and kindly return my money as the fault was not acceptable at allyou should check the date before you deliver because many a time people make shakers without boiling and checking the date due to which food poison can  occur .  I have already gave remarks on hour app and even shared the photo of milk package
Kindly help me out in return of my money.

author: praveenpm
title: Unfair practice
review:
I had placed order for biscuits and ice creams.  Accordingly my account was debited.  When the items were delivered, two ice creams were not there and when I checked the app, it said rose ice cream was unavailable.  When I had a chat with their support team, I was told refund will be initiated and will take 3-5 days to reflect.  This is unfair practice since there app allowed to select all the items I require and then only the payment was made.  While sending the items, they very well knew that all items were not there.  They could have sent a message or informed me about non availability of certain items.  They just sent and I found it while opening the package.  They are enjoying customers money for 3-5 days.  
This is totally unfair practice

author: Isabell2352
title: Very poor customer support
review:
Extremely disappointed with both the product and the customer support experience. I received an electric kettle with quality/functionality issues and immediately contacted support requesting a refund. Instead of resolving the issue, I was repeatedly redirected and asked to contact the brand myself.

What is most frustrating is that the support process took around 3 days, yet I still did not receive a proper resolution.

As a customer purchasing through Blinkit, I expected better ownership and faster resolution of defective product issues. The delay, lack of accountability, and poor customer support have made this a very disappointing experience. I request the Blinkit team to review my case and contact me.

author: Aaarya T
title: Price revised on the final bill
review: Be careful while ordering from this app.  Please always check the final bill summary and may be take screenshot also.I ordered a 1kg item seeing the price as 210. The same item half kg was listed as 106. But when the order got delivered one item is missing and the order summary shown I have not ordered the missing item and the price of one item revised from 210 to 283. They don’t notify if an item gets removed from the final order and the amount revision too. I asked to return and refund they won’t agree to that too. Why would someone buy 1kg for 283 while half kg is placed as 106. The customer support is not really a support. They make us wait quite sometime and come up saying they can’t do anything.

author: Never use blink-it
title: Very bad app not recommended to use
review: I bought the product but when it delivered its not up to the-mark as expectations. I asked them to take it back but their is no return policy for them. They told me if product is damaged or wrongly delivered then only we except return other wise you have to keep the product. My point is if i am not willing to use that product why should i keep it. They are like we sold the material now its your problem whether you liked it or not. I really not happy with the conversation i had with support chat. I request every user please think before you order products from these app if you didn’t like the product they will jot pick that up. Save your money font waste in these app products.

author: AfreenSh
title: Feedback
review: It’s really nice that this app exists. I got to know about it through Zomato. I have some feedback:- -I’m not able to see the complete product name in the product list, the ‘add’ button takes a lot of space. I have to click on each product just to see what the quantity and full name is. Please display the entire ‘product name’ -I also can’t zoom on the product image while in the cart just to read more details or see clearly. I think that can be improved. Thanks:)

author: Suhas_s

review: I chose Blinkit as I was looking for items urgently, delivery agent delivered with missing items and approached for the same he denied that any items is missing and asked me to talk to support for resolution. Initiated chat with support and Agent Aquib was assigned and he mentioned that item is out of stock and cannot be delivered hence I requested for a refund but he denied stating that refund is not possible and disconnected the call. Now I’m left with missing product and had to get the items from other source ending up paying extra money. The worst part is I couldn’t even provide my feedback as it was throwing error while giving unsatisfactory feedback. Not sure if it’s a bug or a cleaverly designed feature

author: Ashish+Verma

review: I don't know what is up with the company these days because from few weeks one cannot order something because of temporary unavailability  or excess demand. I don’t know why these kind of issues are with blinkit right now. Either you should close down the company to stop harassing the customers or if you want to run it, run it properly without any hassle. author: SudVinRao
title: Blinkit: An app that made the lives of thousands of people easier.
review:
Yes, Blinkit truly is a mastermind. One cannot believe how much easier this app has made the lives of many people. With its variety of choices, one can buy literally ANYTHING. Honestly, Blinkit has made life so much easier! I don’t have to run to the store anymore for small things like bread, milk, or vegetables. Whatever I need just shows up at my door in a few minutes. It’s super quick, the app is simple to use, and the delivery is always reliable.

It’s been a real lifesaver in urgent situations — like when I ran out of cooking oil in the middle of making dinner. Instead of stressing, I just ordered on Blinkit and got it in 10 minutes. For busy days or lazy evenings, Blinkit feels like magic.

author: Manoj S manu
title: Blinkit
review:
I ordered a specific charging cable from Blinkit expecting fast and accurate delivery, but unfortunately received the wrong item. The product I got doesn't match the description or specifications I selected. It’s very frustrating, especially when you rely on quick delivery for essentials.

To make matters worse, the app didn't give a straightforward way to report or return the incorrect item. Customer support was slow to respond, and I still haven't received the correct cable or a refund.

Blinkit usually does a good job with groceries, but this experience with electronics was disappointing. Please improve order accuracy and make returns/refunds smoother for customers.

author: Worst and vulgar app
title: Worst service Ever!
review: We have placed an order of kaju katli worth 400₹ on feb 18 we have received a EXPIRED product so we immediately wanted refund but they didnt provide us refund instead they gave us replace.. but the replaced item was also EXPIRED so we complained it to the delivery guy the guy took back the item ans said the money will be refunded. We waited for 2 days and we didn’t receive any refund we wanted to raise a complaint but the blinkit support-said that the complaint window is closed for the order . We didn’t receive any refund.  We even mailed blinkit but they didn’t sort this out. This is the dark reality of them, at least 5 times a week we use blinkit we loved the app but now we litreally hate it how can they do this to their loyal customers?

author: Shankha Subhra Kar
title: Bad Behaviour and service of the delivery executive
review: The delivery boy called me to know the exact location. While I was explaining him he started saying it not the same that is being shown in the map. When I countered him saying that so may delivery guys come to my home on regular basis how come he is being misguided by the gps. He asked me to behave myself in a very rude manner and we had a verbal argument. He then disconnected the call and switched off his mobile. Further he also marked the item as delivered without actually delivering the items.

author: Nagarajan B
title: Absolutely No Support for the customer.
review:
Where is the Customer service support when needed?

Why are your delivery partners looking like they are being hired from School? Why are they so unprofessional? Why are they coming in pairs ( a friend it seems to drive the bike) ? why are these under aged, untrained and uncouth delivery partners calling customer numbers and talking disrespectfully? When in person, why are they giving dumb answers? Can’t find location.. didn’t know there are 3 floors in the building? 

Why should i write a mail and wait for a response when i am using your App for instant delivery? What makes you think that i want instant delivery and bad service but will be ok to wait for your response for my concerns? I

I am sure, I am one customer you don’t care if he switches to Zepto.. Or any other app that gives better service and spends on being customer centric. 

Keep cutting costs in your operations from key areas which makes your app customer friendly, I am sure you will succeed in your long term goals are being a mediocre business that is ok in stay afloat or just doing the bare minimum. 

Cheers!

author: SharmaRashi
title: Not on time, no full order
review:
No delivery in the given 7-8 mins time slot, always taking half an hour saying that your order was not available in the store have to go to other store to collect and still not getting that missing order.
Disappointing service, not going to use it again.
Its better to go physically nearby store or Instamart is better, at-least it shows which item is available or not and arrives on given time 20 mins.
Blinkit was okay before 2 months now its poor, at-least work on the app and mark which item is not available, showing it available on app and still not delivering is just poor service and waste of time, the delivery guys are rude and doesn't follow the location and guidance.

author: Pallavi Mittal
title: Incompetent
review: The most incompetent service I am getting from Blinkit.. If you see my chat history and the issues I have faced I am already giving so many chances to rectify your service but you guys always reply the same standard message and things are not improving. Facing issues like either: - Packaging is torn - Wet and dry items together - Eggs packed with veg items - Broken eggs - Too big Shape and sizes of fruits and vegetables which are raw - items with expiring date of next day or cracked milk - delivery boy marking status as delivered even before delivering the items And so on…list is endless I have even shared most of the images with your team but every time they it won’t happen again.. Horrible horrible customer experience and unsatisfactory service

author: DeeJBTee
title: Quick delivery of items you dont need
review:
The whole idea of this app is that if you need something real quick, they will get it to you. Like you ran out of bread or milk or masala and just need ot delivered quickly. 

But the execution is horrible. More often than not, the item you’d need isn’t available. Or worst, once you place the order, that item goes out of stock.

So if you need that one item (and you might have added a couple of more just so you dont end up paying ₹25 delivery charge for a ₹30 bread), you will just not get the bread. Defeating the purpose of this whole app. Their staff doesn't bother to call up and ask if an item is missing and if he can get another brand or replacement. Just silently don’t deliver the item.

Add to that their customer support is just a bot. Good luck and really thank your lucky stars if you ever get connected to an agent.

You're better off planning your groceries stock. Or whatsapp your local grocery store and wait a bit for them to deliver exactly what you need. At least you’ll get what you need. It’s mostly a miss with an occasional hit.

I’m removing the app.

author: Arpita Oberoi
title: Delivery and quality
review:
I would really like to say that blinkit is the only one to give the items at the correct time and even in the correct quality, there are many different stores to which give delivery on time, but mostly the quality isn’t nice. I always prefer blinkit for any delivery literally on this app, there is every of item like clothes, raincoat can reach Chaturthi items or everything we need in our daily lives. I would really prefer blinkit to everyone around me

Good job♥️

author: Megh13:
title: Horrible customer service
review: Writing this review as this happened twice with me in a very short period of time. I was delivered subpar items and asked to send multiple videos photos to prove the same( please note this was after i sent a few photos/videos). Do you realise the refund of 20-50 bucks is not worth the effort or time you ask the customer to spend for an issue on your side? If you dont trust your customers or need detailed evidences to resolve complaints , i suggest you offer to pick up the item yourself and you can spend as much time u need to record the evidence. In a time where the competition is fierce and customers have other / better options this kind of service or attitude is not going to fly.

author: Dr. M.S. Ali
title: Worst item quality and damaged electronic items delivered!
review:
I have ordered induction cooker and many more things with this app. I got damaged induction plate. I raised replacement request and they delivered another induction cooker. This time i opened it in front of delivery person, and i was also a damaged product! I have complaint against this but 2-3 times they replaced but everytime they gave me a damaged piece. After that they replied keep first one we can not do anything! 

I still have that damaged product and my wife is laughing on me!

author: Fraud deliveries
title: Fraud
review: Ordered 9 items from Blinkit, but the nightmare began when the delivery partner seemed to embark on a joyride, going two streets away and conveniently avoiding calls. Upon his return, he insisted he had been waiting where he clearly wasn't. To make matters worse, my Spigen power bank and Gold Flake pack were mysteriously missing from the incomplete delivery. Seeking resolution, I contacted customer support, only to be met with frustration. They blindly sided with the delivery team, claiming successful delivery. When I pressed for proof, they failed to provide any. Fortunately, I had taken pictures and videos documenting the sorry state of the parcel upon arrival. Blinkit appears to be a breeding ground for deceit, leaving customers with unresolved issues and a sense of dealing with a fraudulent service.

author: Arpitasatpathy
title: I have 1 star but it should be half star
review: I received a completely wrong delivery. Instead of refund I was first told the order will be replaced. Then later I was told few products are out of stock. Then I was given a new order number which did not appear on the app anywhere. This is the worst app ever. No wonder Blinkit has so many advertisements. Off course it is because their inefficiency in operating and managing orders and deliveries. I would rather choose apps like Zepto or Dunzo. This I my last order with Blinkit

author: Dr.Ankur Sharma
title: Good service App with only 50 kgs delivery now
review: One of the best grocery shopping earlier but now they provide only 50 kgs at a single delivery..For every delivery I have to pay 15rs per delivery, earlier i used to buy 13-14k cost products from grofers(now blinkit) but as new rules have been implemented of 50 kgs I avoid blinkit, uses only for 2-5k orders only. If you allow me i will buy 14-15k  products per month but at single delivery. I have now choosen alternative shopping apps because only due to new rules implemented by blinkit which is 50 kgs per delivery.

author: Dunzofan
title: Very poor product sent n no return or refund
review:
I’d ordered a bottle of 24 Mantra organic cold pressed sunflower oil from Blinkit -along with other items- which I needed in an emergency. The bottle was dirty, the oil was cloudy n not safe to use I felt. When I tried to ask for return, replacement or refund, I was made to waste a lot of time on chat, then on call, but to date they’ve not replaced it or refunded my money! This is a major problem with Blinkit( earlier Grofers) : they just don’t entertain complaints or resolve them! You keep banging ur head against a wall… your money isn’t safe with them ! In contrast, Big Basket would have refunded my money in a heartbeat, no questions asked. 
Please don’t order from Blinkit- I’ve faced it multiple times over the last few years!

author: veerangna
title: Delivery of  lies and pathetic customer service
review: I had my first order with blink it on 8 Jan 2022 . There were 17 items . The delivery showed success in 20-25 minutes. I wasn’t home so I saw the message and when I reached home I asked my security and he sd there was a delivery man with one item and he didn’t deliver. The worst part it it’s showing delivered and when I am trying to raise a query with the app they are not responding. There is no phone number or email u can find at the app to convey your complaint. No feedback opportunity nothing.

author: Kritika3
title: Was great when it was Grofers
review: The delivery service is terrible now that it is blinkit. They don’t unpack the items in front of you so you can check the quality. All the frozen and cold items are packed with regular items instead of being brought in a cooler like Grofers used to. When I tried to get a refund for these items from customer support the chat was terrible my text kept vanishing, this is the last straw I’ll be deleting this app. Did I mention they are the only service that charges delivery fees for large orders too?? And still the delivery service is bad! Technical problems with app too so no one even tried to solve my problem, terrible customer service. Basically nothing about it is good, they fail at everything

author: susugamushi
title: An horrifying incident by utterly irresponsible delivery by Blinkit
review: So basically Blinkit people are selling gold coins and delivering them without a proper receipt or packaging. The delivery partner even denied ki hogya jo bhi delivery tha, and denied the coin was ordered in the first place and  said ‘oh Haan main pocket mein rakha tha’ later asked me ki mam ‘ app mein photo Dikhao na gold coin ka’ I disagreed and  I asked him to leave. We was also looking inside the house if there was anyone around when my neighbour passed by and gave him a look. Such an unprofessional behaviour by Blinkit. The incident was horrifying as I was alone in the House.

author: Niftel customer support story
title: Niftel customer support executive
review: I worked at Niftel Communications as a Customer Support Executive for the Blinkit process. In training they said we will handle 3 chats for "few hours", but after joining we had to do those 3 chats for the full 9-hour shift with no break and no time to eat. The work environment is very toxic and there is zero respect. When they want to remove you, they just stop replying to calls and messages. The biggest fraud is salary. They promised ₹16,000 for freshers but in our batch of 22 people, some got ₹1600, some got ₹400, and most got nothing. I also received only ₹1600. Blinkit team, please check your vendor Niftel. They are using Blinkit’s name to hire and exploit freshers. This will ruin Blinkit’s brand. Please take action. I do NOT recommend joining through Niftel.

title: Poor quality & rotten eggs delivered- extremely disappointing experience
review:
I recently ordered Abhi Gold+ Brown eggs from Blinkit, and unfortunately the quality was extremely poor. When I opened the egg tray yesterday, the eggs were completely spoiled and had a very strong foul smell. The odor was so bad that we had to step out of the room for almost 15 minutes and use room freshener afterward. One of the eggs even contained a black, rotten liquid-like mixture inside.

This was a very unpleasant and disappointing experience. I strongly request that you improve and verify the quality checks for sensitive food items like eggs and other perishable products before delivery.

Due to this experience, I’m genuinely disappointed and hesitant to order from Blinkit again.

author: ManishBansal
title: Poor customer service and policies
review: I received my order with broken eggs. I complained and they asked me to provide pictures of all the broken eggs without which they can’t address the issue. My staff had already discarded a few. The customer service executive told me that their policies did not all them to refund for the product unless all the pictures are provided. This is wrong at so many levels. Basically, the mindset to assume that your customer is lying is so offending. I do not have to provide you more than one picture. Even if one is broken, you can welcome to take the eggs back and refund the whole amount. My household billing with Blinkit is easily 6-8K per month. I am happy to take my business somewhere else.

author: Pnkjj

review: Intitally it was good and most of the order delivered between 10-15 minute but since last month their delivery is so pathetic that they take 1 hour and still ask where is your location. Most of the delivery person has no idea how to see maps. Even if you guide them they never reach to your location for next 1 hour. Ultimately you have to cancel your order. Its better to vist shop near you and buy peacefully. Their customer support is also no clue what to do. I am ready to discuss with their higher managment what rubbish going on field if they want anyways that was the last order cancelled no more order from myside untill they do some better. Or delete the app atlast.

author: Nite_9218
title: Good but with shady practices
review:
First off, the delivery system is great. I get groceries delivered every time within minutes, however I’ve had a few problems with this app.
Why would you advertise 10 min deliveries, not only on your adverts, but also as an expected delivery on your orders? This has happened countless times, somethings which were needed in an ainstant due to circumstances, which advertised no more than 10 minutes often get stuck at 8 minutes, like loading bars, and is extremely infuriating. What I thought was better to have been delivered, ends up taking 20 minutes and proves to be a hassle. I would rather it showed me 20 minutes than to be stuck at 8 for 10 minutes before coinntinuing.

author: mitrraa
title: They impose an additional ₹64 charge even on orders as low as ₹60.
review:
I recently had a disappointing experience with Blinkit, an e-commerce app, when I ordered an antacid due to not feeling well. Despite having no other option, I was charged a substantial amount of ₹120. The breakdown of the charges included a handling fee of ₹5, a small cart fee of ₹25, and delivery charges of ₹35, with a minimal discount of ₹1. I felt exploited as they took advantage of my situation. I would advise others to be cautious when using such e-commerce platforms, as they may charge exorbitant amounts. The experience left me feeling disappointed and unhappy with their customer service.
Taking advantage of someone due to their vulnerability is wrong and will ultimately lead to negative consequences for you.

Am I supposed to feel like this situation? Am I supposed to be here like this? This is really a shameful walk on this and also to your team tell them they must learn manners, how to behave

author: Nisha Sahni
title: Incompetent executives
review: Blinkit needs to up their game, with 10 mints delivery sending wrong products and letting incompetent customer care executives they can’t stay here for long. author: MaiaKayina
title: Bad service
review: I ordered two items from Blinkit and received only one item. When I raised this concern, the delivery guy said he will go and check for the other item and then just left and never came back. I contacted the customer support and got only the automated responses. I rescheduled a delivery but it never came. Then I asked for a refund and I am still yet to get my money back. This is not the first time. I have received damaged bananas more than once as it was packed in the bag along with other heavy items and had small items like chips missing. I have never raised an issue before as I understand that sometimes mistakes can happen, but recently the service is getting worse and this has stopped me from using it as often.

author: Mustang_RoyF
title: No longer as it used to be
review:
Writing a review since using this over a year,

Now they’ve started cheating regularly, there’s always items missing in every order. At times even 20+ missing items. After multiple escalations even support team acknowledged that warehouse is regularly withholding items and there are customer escalations regarding the same. Was assured this will be addressed. But it didn’t get addressed. They operate with zero accountability for delivered vs ordered item. They frequently cheat & after initial acknowledgement of issues from their end, now even their support team says “treat it as a one time issue”, while they loot regularly.
Uninstalling Blinkit, there are much better ethical & transparent platforms.
